text: The Riverside Library opens at 9:00 AM on weekdays.
On Saturdays, the Riverside Library opens at 10:00 AM.
The Blue Line train reaches Central Station 18 minutes after leaving Harbor Station.
Harbor Station to Central Station is the shortest route on the Blue Line.
The East Hall conference begins at 2:00 PM.
Registration for the East Hall conference closes 30 minutes before the start.
The community clinic accepts walk-in patients on Tuesday.
The clinic does not publish a fixed closing time for Tuesday walk-ins.
